svg.title: FDAI Azure resource network flow
svg.desc: An operator signs in through Microsoft Entra ID and uses the FDAI Web Console on Azure Static Web Apps. A private Application Gateway protected by a WAF policy routes requests to the separately identified Operator API and optional Ingestion Gateway in the Container Apps infrastructure subnet. Azure Event Hubs, Container Registry, Key Vault, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, and optional ADLS Gen2 storage connect through dedicated private endpoints. The FDAI core and Container Apps Jobs run in the Container Apps subnet. Managed identities authorize workload access. Azure Resource Graph supplies inventory, Application Insights and Log Analytics receive telemetry, and Azure Managed Grafana reads monitoring data. Email, Teams, and Slack carry human approvals. GitHub, GitLab, and Azure DevOps receive governed remediation pull requests.
svg.text: Azure resources, private-endpoint flows, target-state gateway services, and governed delivery channels for FDAI private networking.

Operator. Reader, contributor, approver, owner, or break-glass role
Microsoft Entra ID. Browser authentication and App Roles
FDAI Web Console. Browser-based projections and bounded governed requests
Application Gateway. Private ingress for operator and ingestion requests
WAF policy. Managed protection attached to Application Gateway
Operator API Container App. Separate read and command transport identities with no executor permission
Container Apps Jobs. Inventory, detection, canary, measurement, and resilience jobs
FDAI core Container App. Fifteen agents, trust router, safety checks, and privileged executor
Ingestion Gateway (optional). Authenticated document upload and governed ingestion
Event Hubs. Event Hubs
Registry. Registry
Key Vault. Key Vault
Azure OpenAI. Azure OpenAI
Microsoft Foundry. Microsoft Foundry
PostgreSQL. PostgreSQL
Blob (optional). Blob (optional)
DFS (optional). DFS (optional)
Azure Event Hubs. Kafka :9093 topics, control topics, replay, and dead-letter streams
Azure Container Registry. Signed images pinned by digest
Azure Key Vault. Native Container Apps secret references
Azure OpenAI. Optional governed T2 model capabilities
Microsoft Foundry. Governed model, evaluation, and agent project plane
Azure Database for PostgreSQL. State, append-only audit, operator memory, and pgvector
ADLS Gen2 Storage Account (optional). Quarantine, governed source, and derived filesystems
User-assigned managed identities. Separate executor, inventory, read, command, and job principals
Azure Resource Graph. Subscription and resource inventory through the Azure control plane
Application Insights and Log Analytics. Traces, metrics, logs, alerts, and correlation
Azure Managed Grafana. Governed dashboards over Azure Monitor data
GitHub. Reviewable and reversible change delivery
GitLab. Reviewable and reversible change delivery
Azure DevOps. Reviewable and reversible change delivery
Email. Azure Communication Services email adapter
Microsoft Teams. Human approval with a separate approver identity
Slack. Reauthenticated approval and notification adapter
